nextTask: V3-04 repair — address the 2 remaining must-fix findings on the preserved WIP baseline. (1) CURRENCY-ONLY EXPENSE EDIT: balances.tsx lines 321-355 detect modified expenses by comparing amountMinor, paidByMemberId, participantMemberIds, splitMode and customShares — but NOT currency. The Add-tab edit form exposes an editable currency field and persists it, so a currency-only edit (CHF→EUR) is classified as unmodified; the old CHF effect stays and the new EUR effect is never applied, corrupting the all-time moneyByCurrency snapshot. Fix: add `currency` (and verify no other ledger-affecting field is missing) to the modification detection condition so a changed currency triggers remove-old + apply-new. Add a test that performs a currency-only edit and asserts the all-time moneyByCurrency snapshot equals calculateFinancialBalancesByCurrency full replay (old currency zeroed, new currency carries the amount). (2) SCREEN-LEVEL TEST: the header now claims 'Screen-level: delta handler re-reads only the changed collection' but the tests at lines 432-481 and 1071-1105 build a local Set pub/sub stand-in and never import app/(tabs)/balances.tsx or AppContext. Either (a) add a test that imports the screen with jest.mock('expo-router'), provides fake repos with counted reads, drives add/edit/delete through the data-change signal, and asserts rendered delta + bounded reads; or (b) remove the word 'Screen-level' from claim #8 and reword it to an explicitly data-level/handler claim the tests actually prove. Do not leave a claim the tests do not exercise. Also strengthen the settlement exactly-once test (lines 557-620) to guard the fix: assert that handleCompenserConfirm does not emit 'settlement' or that a second application would be rejected. Preserve all V3-01/V3-02/V3-03 acceptance.
